name: sidequest
description: 2048 and a Wordle built from your own project's words, in a pane beside the chat — played from the prompt, so the keyboard never has to move.

after_seconds.title: Open after
after_seconds.description: Seconds a turn must run before the pane opens by itself; 0 never opens it unasked

mode.title: Game
mode.description: Which game the pane opens on; t switches between them at any time

word_length.title: Word length
word_length.description: How many letters the word game asks for. mixed varies it each round, which uses the most of a project's vocabulary. A length the project has too few words for falls back to the one it has most of.
